data.description: A bank of fog billows out from the point you designate. The fog obscures all sight, including darkvision, beyond 5 feet. A creature within 5 feet has concealment [attacks have a 20%% miss chance]. Creatures farther away have total concealment [50%% miss chance, and the attacker can't use sight to locate the target]. A moderate wind [11+ mph] disperses the fog in 4 rounds; a strong wind [21+ mph] disperses the fog in 1 round. The spell does not function underwater.
